name: Pocket Burst-Reset
description: Two to three crisp close-range strikes followed immediately by guard and stance restoration.

name: Pocket Rhythm Shadow
description: Rehearse two or three compact pocket actions in shadow, restore guard, then settle with no impact or sustained flurry.

name: Pressure Lane Shadow
description: Smooth ring or cage cutting against visualised exits with no sustained flurry.

name: Cover-Return-Exit
description: Read a light cue, cover or parry, return briefly, then exit cleanly.

name: Visual Counter Shadow
description: Coach gives a visual cue; rehearse the response without impact, then settle.

name: Range Gate-Score-Exit
description: Enter only on the range cue, score once, then immediately restore preferred distance.

name: Long-Range Rhythm Shadow
description: Quiet stance and range rhythm with occasional single intercepts and no bouncing contest.

name: Single-Kick Recoil Primer
description: Deliver one crisp kick to a light pad and restore stance immediately without combination volume.

name: Kick Timing Shadow Cue
description: Respond to a visual cue with one unloaded kick motion, then return to a quiet stance.

name: Pummel-Frame-Exit Flow
description: Co-operative pummel to frame and clean exit with no sustained clinch battle.

name: Clinch Frame-Exit Shadow
description: Rehearse posture, frame placement and exit footwork against an imagined clinch without partner contact.

name: Position-Attack Entry-Release
description: Enter the preferred submission configuration, establish mechanics briefly, release before maximal squeeze, then reset.

name: Submission Entry Map Shadow
description: Rehearse the preferred submission-entry pathway solo on the mat, stopping before any squeeze or loaded finish.

name: Hip-Heist-Re-square
description: Perform one controlled hip-heist recovery and immediately establish a stable square position.

name: Scramble Base Reset Shadow
description: Rehearse one quiet scramble-to-base pathway on the mat, settle posture, then reset without speed chasing or resistance.

name: Position Touch-Reset
description: Enter a preferred grappling position against light resistance, establish briefly, then disengage before fatigue.

name: Grappling Base-Position Shadow
description: Move through the athlete's preferred base, hip-line and re-square positions solo with no partner resistance.

name: Level-Change-Entry-Recover
description: Perform one clean level change and initial penetration action without a hard finish, then recover stance.

name: Circle-Re-shot Cue
description: Partner circles; reposition, show the re-shot entry, then reset without finishing hard.

name: Re-shot Rhythm Shadow
description: Rehearse re-position, level-change and re-shot rhythm solo, then recover stance without a finish.

name: Standing Stance-Set Cue
description: From a relaxed standing stance, respond to a visual or self cue with one small stance adjustment and freeze in balance. No strikes, jumps, level changes or contact; fully relax between cues.

name: Shadowboxing Technical Rhythm
description: Rehearse light striking cadence and stance organisation without a sustained flurry or conditioning demand.

name: Assault Bike Rhythm Primer
description: Use brief cadence touches and easy pedalling to retain machine rhythm without creating an aerobic workload.

name: Body-Head Burst-Exit
description: One compact body shot into one head shot, then a single clean exit step and guard reset.

name: Hook-Cross-Pivot Burst
description: Short rotational hook-cross pair followed immediately by a pivot off the line and guard restoration.

name: Pocket Frame-Burst Touch
description: Absorb one cooperative pressure touch, frame, return two crisp pocket shots, then reset stance.

name: Cut-Off-Step-Score
description: Partner shows one escape lane; cut it off with a single explosive step, land one crisp score, stop.

name: Herd-Corner-Burst-Reset
description: Partner gives an escape cue; seal the lane and answer with a two-shot burst, then reset to neutral range.

name: Step-Jab-Cutoff Cue
description: Explosive first pressure step behind a jab, seal the angle, then settle - no follow-up flurry.

name: Cutoff-Low-Kick Touch
description: Close the escape lane with one step and answer with a single low kick, then re-square and stop.

name: Parry-Cross-Exit
description: One partner cue, one parry, one straight return, then immediate exit and guard reset.

name: Slip-Cross-Pivot
description: Slip one telegraphed cue, answer with a single straight, then pivot out to a new angle.

name: Pull-Counter-Reset
description: Draw one attack, take a small pull off the end of it, return once, then restore stance.

name: Check-Return-Kick
description: Check one cooperative kick cue and answer with a single return kick, then re-square.

name: Shuffle-In-Score-Angle-Out
description: Explosive shuffle to close range, one clean score, then an angled exit back to long range.

name: Intercept-Step-Straight
description: A cue triggers one intercepting step and straight on the way in, then immediate recovery to range.

name: Pendulum Jab-Cross Reset
description: Brief long-range hand-speed action from a pendulum step, then settle back to guard.

name: Range Feint-Entry-Exit
description: One feint at range, one rapid entry, one shot, then clean exit - no second entry.

name: Teep-Recoil-Re-square
description: Single teep to manage range, fast recoil of the kicking leg, then re-square to stance.

name: Lead-Kick Snap-Recover
description: One snapping lead kick with an immediate controlled recovery to a balanced stance.

name: Punch-Cue-Low-Kick Counter
description: Partner shows one hand cue; answer with a single low kick, recover the leg, then stop.

name: Hand-Entry-Single-Kick Reset
description: One short hand entry into a single kick, then recoil and re-square with no follow-up volume.

name: Pummel-Underhook-Reset
description: Two crisp pummels to a dominant underhook, then release the tie and reset to neutral posture.

name: Inside-Tie Snap-Reset
description: Snap to an inside tie from neutral posture, hold the position for a beat, then release cleanly.

name: Clinch Knee-Touch Entry
description: Enter the clinch, place one light knee touch, then break the tie - early taper only, never a knee volume set.

name: Solo Frame-Turn Exit Cue
description: Shadow the clinch frame, turn the corner and exit, with no partner load and no sustained tie.

name: Arm-Drag-Back-Catch-Release
description: One arm drag to back exposure, catch the position, then release immediately - no finishing squeeze.

name: Front-Headlock-Capture-Release
description: Snap to front-headlock control, establish the position for one beat, then release without squeezing.

name: Armbar Entry-Catch-Release
description: Acquire the armbar entry configuration quickly, stop at the catch, then release - no loaded joint finish.

name: Guillotine Position-Catch-Release
description: Take the guillotine position from a front-headlock touch, confirm the grip, then release with no squeeze.

name: Sprawl-Re-shot Touch
description: Sprawl on one cooperative entry cue, recover posture, then answer with a single re-shot touch.

name: Sit-Out-Re-square
description: One crisp sit-out from a bottom touch, then re-square to a balanced base and stop.

name: Turtle-Technical-Stand
description: From turtle, execute one technical stand to a squared base, then reset down - single repetition per burst.

name: Snapdown-Go-Behind Touch
description: One snapdown into a go-behind touch on the back position, then release and reset to neutral.

name: Body-Lock Entry-Position Touch
description: Enter to a body lock, confirm the position for one beat, then release - no lift and no finish.

name: Pass-Entry-Control Touch
description: One crisp guard-pass entry to a control touch, then release the position and reset.

name: Fake-Shot-Go
description: Show one convincing fake, read the reaction, then commit to a single entry and recover stance.

name: Touch-and-Go Entry
description: One light tie touch to set the level, then a single explosive entry and immediate stance recovery.

name: Penetration-Step-Recover
description: One penetration step to depth, then stand back to a squared stance - single rep, no finish.

name: Explosive Straight Burst
description: Pure hand-speed burst: rapid straight punches in the air at maximal crispness, then full recovery.

name: Explosive First-Step Cue
description: Pure acceleration cue: one maximal-intent first step from fighting stance, then stop and reset.

name: Position-Read Control Touch
description: Partner shows one of two openings; take the matching control position, confirm it, then release.

name: Entry-Read Catch-Release
description: Partner shows one of two openings; take the matching submission entry to the catch, then release.

name: Solo Back-Exposure Snap
description: Snap solo through one back-exposure path to a controlled finish shape, then reset to base.

name: Solo Submission Entry Snap
description: Snap solo into one submission-entry shape at speed, hold one beat, then release and reset.

name: Shadow Pocket Burst-Freeze
description: Shadow two compact pocket shots, freeze the guard, then settle - zero contact, zero impact.

name: Cutoff Step-Set Cue
description: Shadow one cut-off step and set the stance, then hold still - zero contact, zero impact.

name: Slip-Return Shadow Cue
description: Shadow one slip and one return, then restore guard and stop - zero contact, zero impact.

name: Shuffle-Angle-Set Cue
description: Shadow one shuffle and one angle change, then set the stance - zero contact, zero impact.

name: Shadow Kick-Recoil Cue
description: Shadow one kick and its recoil to stance, with no pad, no partner and no impact.

name: Shadow Frame-Turn-Set
description: Shadow one clinch frame and corner turn, then set posture - no partner, no tie, no load.

name: Solo Entry-Position Snap
description: Snap solo into one submission-entry shape, hold it for a beat, then release - no partner, no squeeze.

name: Hip-Heist-Base Snap
description: One solo hip heist to a squared base, then stop - no partner and no scramble volume.

name: Solo Arm-Drag Footwork Cue
description: Shadow one arm-drag path with the feet only, then reset to base - no partner and no grip load.

name: Level-Change-Penetration Snap
description: One solo level change into a short penetration step, then stand and stop - no partner, no finish.
